service.description: Handle MCP initialize request using Moqui authentication
Handle MCP tools/call — dispatches to agent-oriented MCP tools
Handle MCP ping request — returns server health and session info
Return the list of available MCP tools

actions.script:
import groovy.json.JsonSlurper Set<String> userGroupIdSet = (ec.user.userGroupIdSet ?: []) as Set boolean isDebugUser = userGroupIdSet.contains('MCP_DEBUG') || userGroupIdSet.contains('ADMIN')
List<Map<String, Object>> runtimeTools = [ ]
List debugTools = [ [ name: "moqui_search_artifacts", title: "Search Artifacts", description: "Privileged artifact search across indexed services, entities, XSD schemas and docs in moqui_artifacts_v1. Use for direct artifact discovery when no suitable skill or agent document covers the use case.", inputSchema: [ type: "object", properties: [ queryText: [type: "string", description: "Natural language query (e.g. 'create invoice for customer')"], artifactTypeList: [type: "array", items: [type: "string"], description: "Filter by type: service, entity, screen, xsd, doc"], componentNameList: [type: "array", items: [type: "string"], description: "Filter by component name"], searchMode: [type: "string", description: "Search mode: bm25, knn, hybrid (default: system property)"], limit: [type: "integer", description: "Max results (default 20)"] ], required: ["queryText"] ] ], [ name: "moqui_get_artifact", title: "Get Artifact", description: "Privileged artifact inspection by type and name. Returns full artifact document from moqui_artifacts_v1 including XSD schema definitions, service parameters, and entity fields.", inputSchema: [ type: "object", properties: [ artifactType: [type: "string", description: "Artifact type: service, entity, screen, xsd, doc"], artifactName: [type: "string", description: "Canonical artifact name from moqui_search_artifacts results"] ], required: ["artifactType", "artifactName"] ] ], [ name: "moqui_search_all", title: "Search All Documents", description: "Unified search across both moqui_agent_prompts_v1 (agent documents and knowledge documents) and moqui_artifacts_v1 (raw artifacts). Use when you need a comprehensive view of what is available for a given query.", inputSchema: [ type: "object", properties: [ queryText: [type: "string", description: "Natural language query"], limit: [type: "integer", description: "Max results per index (default 5)"], searchMode: [type: "string", description: "Search mode: bm25, knn, hybrid"] ], required: ["queryText"] ] ], [ name: "moqui_call_service_guarded", title: "Call Service Guarded", description: "Privileged direct service execution with Moqui authz checks and confirmation for high-risk operations.", inputSchema: [ type: "object", properties: [ serviceName: [type: "string", description: "Service name in verb#noun format (e.g. 'mantle.account.InvoiceServices.create#Invoice')"], parameters: [type: "object", description: "Service input parameters"], confirmed: [type: "boolean", description: "Explicit confirmation required for high-risk operations"] ], required: ["serviceName"] ] ], [ name: "moqui_discover_artifacts", title: "Discover and Index Artifacts", description: "Privileged runtime auto-discovery: scans component directories (service, entity, screen, XSD), extracts artifact metadata, and bulk-indexes into moqui_artifacts_v1. Requires ADMIN or MCP_INDEX_ADMIN.", inputSchema: [ type: "object", properties: [ componentNameList: [type: "array", items: [type: "string"], description: "Component names to scan (omit for all)"], artifactTypeList: [type: "array", items: [type: "string"], description: "Artifact types: service, entity, screen, xsd"], forceReindex: [type: "boolean", description: "Delete and recreate the index before indexing"], generateEmbeddings: [type: "boolean", description: "Generate embeddings via configured provider"], batchSize: [type: "integer", description: "Indexing batch size (default 100)"] ] ] ], [ name: "moqui_discovery_status", title: "Discovery Index Status", description: "Returns document counts by artifact type and index health for moqui_artifacts_v1.", inputSchema: [ type: "object", properties: [ indexName: [type: "string", description: "Index name (default: moqui_artifacts_v1)"] ] ] ] ]
List toolList = [] toolList.addAll(runtimeTools) if (isDebugUser) toolList.addAll(debugTools) def jsonSlurper = new JsonSlurper() ec.entity.find('moqui.service.ServiceRegister').condition('serviceTypeEnumId', 'McpToolProvider').useCache(true).list()?.each { providerReg -> try { Map cfg = [:] if (providerReg.configParameters) cfg = (Map) jsonSlurper.parseText(providerReg.configParameters) String listServiceName = providerReg.serviceName Map providerRes = ec.service.sync().name(listServiceName).parameters(sessionId ? [sessionId: sessionId] : [:]).call() List providerTools = (providerRes?.toolList ?: providerRes?.tools ?: []) as List if (providerTools) toolList.addAll(providerTools) } catch (Throwable t) { ec.logger.warn("Unable to list MCP tools from provider ${providerReg.serviceRegisterId}: ${t.message}") } } result = [tools: toolList]
